correctness.rationale: Reconstructed T action off the integer grid as Q(m,n)=(-n-1,m) for n<0 and (-n,m-1) for n>=0, exact ten-case integer rank h, and strict h(Q)=h-1 outside the absorbing labels (0,0),(0,-1); this proves finite entry for every off-grid point without finite extrapolation. In the trap, T exchanges the two squares and T^2 reflects each square, giving T^4=id and exactly two period-two centers. Counting rank cases yields a0=2 and a_{2k-1}=a_{2k}=2k; summation gives 2+2s(1+s)/(1-s^2)^2. Ten cases also establish |h(m,n)-2(|m|+|n|)|<=3; floor-coordinate errors add <=4, so coupling yields W1<=7/R and the triangular density on [0,4].
